description: This Java source file defines the RecordIterator class, which provides functionality to read and iterate over records in large data files, supporting fixed-length and delimited record styles, with handling for different encodings and record models.

classes.name: RecordIterator
classes.description: Provides an iterator interface for reading and processing records from large data files, supporting fixed and delimited formats, with record model matching and hierarchical parent-child relationships.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iterator with a URL to a data file and a corresponding data model.

methods.name: RecordIterator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iterator with an input stream, data model, and location info.

methods.name: setupStream
methods.description: Configures the input stream, wraps with a buffered reader, and positions at the start line.

methods.name: getNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next line or fixed-length record from the data stream and creates a Record object.

methods.name: getCurrentLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the current line number being processed.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more records to read.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next Record in the iteration, handling hierarchical parent-child relationships.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the input stream and releases resources.
